propositions: agents preferentially use grep for source reference enumeration despite documentation guidance favoring Serena symbol tools, due to friction asymmetry and working memory decay
Serena LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr, getattr) but grep can, making the stated preference factually incorrect in those cases
Serena's index can lag behind recent edits, causing stale line numbers to be reported while grep operates on the current tree
grep produces false positives (e.g., symbol matches in comments) that Serena does not, requiring both tools for complete accuracy
the workflow should surface Serena's symbol tools at the moment of grep invocation via a PreToolUse hook reminder, and remove discovery friction by pre-loading tools via settings
a project-only criterion and coaching move should direct agents to re-derive incompletely enumerated source references using Serena
